steps.label: Mean-variance
steps.sub: optimal on paper, fragile in practice

code:
vol = returns.rolling(60).std()
inv_vol = 1 / vol
weights = inv_vol.div(
    inv_vol.sum(axis=1), axis=0)
caption: A low-vol asset gets a bigger position to carry the same risk weight.

inv_cov = np.linalg.inv(cov)

w = raw / raw.sum()
# tiny errors in mu -> wild w
caption: Small errors in expected returns can produce extreme, unstable weights.

subtitle: Sizing a single position correctly, and the risk of over-levering an estimate.
